sources.locator: "Referendo à despenalização do aborto em Portugal (2007)", revision 71782356

title: 2007 Portuguese abortion referendum
summary: Portugal was asked again on 11 February 2007 whether abortion at the woman's request up to ten weeks should cease to be a crime, and this time the yes won, with about fifty-nine per cent. Turnout was under a half, so the result was again not binding; the Assembly legislated on it anyway, and the law of April 2007 ended the criminal provision. It is in the atlas as the answer to the question of 1998 — the same question, nine years and one generation apart, decided the other way and by a margin nobody disputed.

actors.role: called the referendum and legislated on the result
